class Solution:
    def longestValidSubstring(self, word: str, forbidden: List[str]) -> int:
        # Initialize variables as per ILR node 2
        res = 0
        right = len(word) - 1
        
        # Create forbidden_set from forbidden list as per ILR node 3
        forbidden_set = set(forbidden)
        
        # Loop left from length of word - 1 to 0 as per ILR node 5
        left = len(word) - 1
        while left >= 0:
            # For each left, loop k from left to min(left + 10, right + 1) as per ILR node 6
            k = left
            while k <= min(left + 10, right + 1):
                k += 1
                if k > right + 1:
                    break
                
                # Check if substring word[left:k] is in forbidden_set as per ILR node 7
                substring = word[left:k]
                if substring in forbidden_set:
                    # Update right = k - 1 as per ILR node 8
                    right = k - 1
                    break
            
            # Update result with max of current res and (right - left + 1)
            res = max(res, right - left + 1)
            left -= 1
        
        return res
